license_note: Every volume here must be public domain with a recorded basis (pre-1930 imprint, archive rights statement, or CC0 release). Modern copyrighted translations (Santhanam, B.V. Raman, G.C. Sharma, Dykes, etc.) are intentionally absent even when the underlying classical text is ancient. The classical Sanskrit originals are public domain by age; only verifiably free editions are stored.

sources.title: The Brihat Jataka of Varaha Mihira
sources.author: Varahamihira
sources.edition: Foster Press, Madras (trans. N. Chidambaram Iyer)
sources.rights: Public domain in the US (Internet Archive: NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT)
sources.pd_basis: Published 1885, pre-1930 US publication; Google/Harvard scan of a public-domain edition.
sources.note: Classical hora text: graha natures, bhavas, drishti (aspects), yogas and varga use.

sources.title: Jaimini Sutras (Upadesa Sutras)
sources.author: Jaimini
sources.edition: 1955 reprint of the B. Suryanarain Rao translation
sources.rights: Public domain in India (translator died 1937, life+60); translation first published pre-1930
sources.pd_basis: Rao's translation predates 1930 (US public domain); the 1955 reprint adds no new authorship. The engine already cites this edition in src/core/chara_dasha.py.
sources.note: Chara karakas (AK-DK), arudhas (AL/UL), rashi dashas, Jaimini transits.

sources.title: The Brihat Samhita of Varaha Mihira
sources.author: Varahamihira
sources.pd_basis: Published 1865; well past every copyright term.
sources.note: Mundane astrology: rainfall, earthquakes, omens (nimitta), architecture chapters.

sources.title: Mantreswara's Phaladeepika
sources.author: Mantreswara
sources.edition: Aruna Press, Bangalore (trans. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
sources.rights: Public domain (Digital Library of India rights statement: 'In Public Domain')
sources.pd_basis: DLI metadata declares the scan public domain; Sastri's translation is a pre-war South Indian edition.
sources.note: A primary timing text: dasha judgment, yogas, bhava and lord analysis.

sources.title: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra with the Subodhini commentary
sources.author: Parashara
sources.edition: Khemraj Shrikrishnadas, Mumbai 1923 (Sanskrit verses with Hindi commentary)
sources.rights: Public domain (CC0 1.0 release by eGangotri / Sarayu Trust)
sources.pd_basis: Published 1923 (pre-1930); the scanning publisher released the file under CC0 1.0.
sources.note: Primary Parashari source in Devanagari (Sanskrit + Hindi). Indexed for completeness; English keyword search cannot match Devanagari, so use it for human verification and locators.

sources.title: Saravali of Kalyana Varma (manuscript scan)

sources.note: Partial manuscript scan (18 folios). English translations of Saravali are modern and copyrighted, so only this PD manuscript is stored.
